title: Before They Are Hanged
author: Joe Abercrombie
review:
Doesn't deliver on the promise of the first novel and there's some character development that seemed somewhat unearned and a little jarring. Biggest gripe is that many of the characters don't have that much of an impact on the overarching plot so it can seem fairly anticlimactic and the world building continues to not be a focus. The main villains are also not too fleshed out and a little generic.

It is a little puzzling that this series is compared to a Song of Ice and Fire when it doesn't come close to the highs of that series so far. That being said, I do enjoy the moment to moment reading of the series and a lot of the characters are fantastic. Hoping that further entries payoff from this slightly awkward middle book.
